inj.note: Before making his season debut Week 7, Jacobs missed the Packers' first six games after he was placed on the commissioner's exempt list after he was officially charged Aug. 27 with two misdemeanors stemming from his May arrest for a domestic incident. The legal process related to that incident has since played out, but Jacobs' status with the team had been called into question after the NFL announced Saturday that it was reviewing additional allegations of physical and verbal abuse from three different women in incidents dating back to April 2021 that were released following a public records request. Unless the NFL elects to place him back on the exempt list while it reviews the incidents in question, Jacobs looks like he'll be available for Green Bay's next game Sunday at New England. Despite the missed time to begin the season, Jacobs has immediately settled back into a lead role in the backfield and has scored three touchdowns in two games, but he's mustered just 75 yards on 32 carries (2.3 average) to go with 11 receptions for 68 yards on 13 targets.

news.h: Packers sticking with RB Josh Jacobs despite latest abuse allegations
news.d: Packers coach Matt LaFleur says the team is sticking with RB Josh Jacobs despite new allegations of abuse levied by multiple women in addition to a May incident that led to his arrest.

news.h: Additional allegations against Packers' Josh Jacobs 'unsupported,' attorneys say
news.d: The attorneys for Green Bay's Josh Jacobs called the additional allegations of physical and verbal abuse "unsupported and stale allegations" in a statement on Sunday, two days after a police department in Wisconsin released records related to his arrest.

news.h: NFL to review additional allegations against Packers RB Josh Jacobs
news.d: The NFL said it will look into additional allegations of physical and verbal abuse by Packers RB Josh Jacobs that were revealed as part of a public records release from the Hobart/Lawrence Police Department.

news.h: Records show 3 other women accused Packers' Josh Jacobs of abuse after arrest
news.d: Three other women contacted police to detail allegations of abuse against Packers RB Josh Jacobs following his May arrest for an altercation with his then-girlfriend.

news.h: Packers' Josh Jacobs: TD celebration was ode to gospel song, not mocking arrest
news.d: The Packers' Josh Jacobs said he was surprised his first-half TD celebration was perceived by some as mocking his May arrest, saying it was an ode to a gospel song.
